annotations.title: Take a shared piece into the folder

description: Bring a piece somebody shared into the working folder (pieces/), with the pieces it needs: it is then used by its id like any piece of the library (add_shot, set_transition, create_film with a shared template…), and a film that uses it carries its recipe. A piece is data that was read and drawn before a person approved it, never code that runs.

id.description: The id of a shared piece (see search_community), e.g. transition/c-k3m9x2p7q4wd
